reconstruction.scope: Specific standing Yueyang Tower exterior: three decreasing golden curved roofs/strongly upswept corners, rounded upper ridge/finial, dark red/brown timber columns and bracket blocks, open middle balcony/geometric rails, closed upper lattice panels and bounded stone plinth/entrance treads. Four existing shared stone/timber/panel/glazed-tile graphs; original simplified geometry, no copied photos or pseudo-calligraphy. No furnished interior, whole city-wall gate/frontage, adjacent green pavilion, park platform, trees or tourist props.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Neither retained Wikidata nor the native PMTiles shell supplies measured height. Nominal18.9m above the attachment plane (occupied plinth top0.65m) is a picture-led visualization estimate, not a sourced surveyed dimension. Three roof eaves at5.5/10.7/15.4m, respective rises2.8/2.55/2.6m, strongly lifted corners, upper ridge bulge0.35m and0.55m finial preserve relative picture proportions. Floor/plinth, wall/column/roof dimensions, lattice/bracket inventory and later repair condition remain approximate.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Retain original6m standard Mapzen grid, all independent mapped neighbors including the nearby green-roofed pavilion, native paths/steps and lake/water. Replace only the tower shell. A bounded level occupied plinth sits just above the highest sampled footprint rim; its buried sides extend below the lowest rim and short supported treads meet native grade. No terrain/water cutout or whole park/city-wall platform. Coarse DEM cannot resolve the city-wall gate masonry and is not surveyed foundation evidence; the separate wall/frontage gate remains outside this tower exterior scope.
